idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18 at peak, all regions on v2.3.1). Last production release that was healthy is v2.3.0, so I rolled back to v2.3.0. My first rollback attempt halted with a partial failure after us-east (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1). I retried the rollback to v2.3.0, which completed in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Current state: v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure during rollback; v2.3.1 must not be redeployed to production until it is fixed and has passed health checks. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy there, and v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging. v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production, so no change-manager approval was needed.
- **Rollback:** The first attempt halted with a partial failure after us-east, leaving the service mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1). I retried the same rollback, and it completed in us-east, us-west and eu-west.
- **Current state:** All regions are on v2.3.0 and healthy, with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.
- **Incident:** The first incident request timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, so it opened once as INC-0001. The summary covers the v2.3.1 failure, the partial rollback failure, and the current state.

Follow-ups for the on-call engineer:
- Investigate why v2.3.1 failed health checks.
- Investigate the orchestrator partial failure during the first rollback attempt.
- Keep v2.3.1 out of production until it is fixed and passes health checks.

content.text: The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging). v2.3.0 has been healthy in production, so it doesn't need change-manager approval. Rolling back now.
The rollback reported a partial failure after us-east. I'll check the current state of each region before doing anything else.
The rollout is in a mixed state: us-east is on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on the unhealthy v2.3.1. Retrying the same rollback, which is the action you asked for.
All three regions are on v2.3.0 and healthy again (error rate 0.2%). Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
